prompt:
Create ONE finished full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card of Sun Quan from Romance of the Three Kingdoms reimagined as an adult woman — emperor of Wu and sovereign of the Yangtze. About twenty, a fresh young-adult face with no facial lines. She is a woman with no beard, moustache or facial hair.

Style: Korean MMORPG 3D key art — a semi-realistic 3D beauty with a small refined face and delicate realistic-anime features, porcelain skin with a soft glow, extremely ornate engraved armour and jewellery with glossy highlights, a strong rim light and drifting light particles, a luxurious promotional finish.

Fair skin, pale violet almond eyes, a compact soft diamond face and deep wine-red hair in a smooth high braided bun with long side locks. Cranberry lips and a spirited confident expression. Choose large metal feathered wing ornaments spreading from her shoulders and a wing-shaped head ornament. Ornate crimson-and-black enamel breastplate with a deep neckline, bare shoulders, golden articulated wing ornaments, river-teal split skirt panels and elaborate high boots. Build her crimson fleet into the wing construction: layered metal feather plates take the swept triangular shape of taut galleon sails with gold structural ribs; their layers form the actual armour assembly. Sovereign crown above her hairline, gold jewellery and engraved fittings. Her single imperial straight double-edged sword is a Western high-fantasy version of the jian silhouette, polished steel and mithril, runic metal hilt, jeweled guard, leather grip, subtle magical blade glow, red heraldic sword-knot replacing the red tassel; no Chinese ornaments or wood. She stands turned slightly toward the viewer with both feet on the ground, one hand holding the sword point downward away from her body, her free hand open at her side. Sunlit medieval red-stone harbour gate, crimson galleons on the broad river delta and distant fire beacons. Western medieval dress and setting only; no Chinese architecture, robes, junks or hanzi.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin — never a long face or a long, pointed or heavy jaw; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline and never lengthens her face. Her eyes stay at a natural open size — never squeezed into narrow slits. A voluptuous feminine figure with a full bust, narrow waist and balanced human hips and long legs.

Costume colours: crimson red, gold, river teal, black lacquer. Her sovereign rank is immediately clear: layered, richly ornate and regal with flagship-card detail, engraving and jewellery, never plain or sparse. Exposure: bold — her outfit shows skin by deliberate design, a deep neckline, bare shoulders or arms, and a high slit or short hem; intimate areas covered.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her crown or headpiece to both boots stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every genre; her hands and her signature item stay inside the frame. Camera at chest height with natural portrait perspective — no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

Light: a strong soft rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour, glossy highlights on metal, skin and jewellery, drifting light particles and a luxurious promotional glow. One figure only, natural hands with five fingers; no logo or watermark.
